purpose: Retrospective delay-case diagnostics for fixed supplied pilot paths; not a historical route-provider benchmark or an unbiased success-rate estimate.
origin: Hayden LIC Apartments, 43-25 Hunter Street, Long Island City, NY 11101
destination: NYU Tandon School of Engineering, 6 MetroTech Center, Brooklyn, NY 11201
candidate_scope: Two fixed direct subway paths supplied for this experiment; historical trip stop order must confirm each candidate. This is not an exhaustive route search.
walking_policy: Author-selected rounded access-to-platform and exit-to-destination assumptions. Current provider routes were consulted only to sanity-check these values; no historical walking or provider-candidate availability is asserted.

routes.name: F: Court Sq-23 St to Jay St-MetroTech
G: Court Sq to Hoyt-Schermerhorn Sts

delay_case_rule.meaning: The baseline-selected train's inferred destination arrival is at least five minutes later than its as-of MTA prediction, after the same fixed walks. This is a retrospective case-selection rule, not a switching threshold.

model_policy: Reuse unchanged frozen models. Arrival and departure models were not adopted; departure-plus-segment results are research diagnostics only. Never add an arrival residual to departure or riding time.
strict_decision_policy: Require fresh applicable train and alert evidence; keep conditional timing ranking separate from an eligible Stay/Switch recommendation.
outcome_policy: Use the same predicted-selected service-qualified train and its quality-screened final-prediction journal endpoints. Missed or unverified boarding yields an unavailable outcome rather than hindsight substitution.
walking_sensitivity_policy: Vary each route's access and egress independently, recomputing catchability and the MTA-fastest reference in every scenario; report reference changes.
